Extract Dublin Core metadata tags

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><title>Scholarly Work</title><meta name=\"DC.title\" content=\"Principles of Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.creator\" content=\"Dr. Alice Johnson\"><meta name=\"DC.date\" content=\"2023-06-15\"><meta name=\"DC.subject\" content=\"Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.publisher\" content=\"Academic Press\"></head><body><p>This is a scholarly article.</p></body></html>", "{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
